programs.name: saturating_count_relief
programs.rationale: Ranks reward per closed-neighborhood count with bounded relief for larger degrees. Reach is local count only; arithmetic is constant size and degree updates remain charged. Relief may overvalue heavily connected contacts.

programs.name: blended_blocker_load
programs.rationale: Blends blocker count with conflict weight normalized by root reward, preserving separate count and weight scales. Reach is the immediate neighborhood; constant-size arithmetic adds no features, but aggregate updates remain charged and blocker mass can overstate feasible displacement.

programs.name: bounded_rival_correction
programs.rationale: Uses count efficiency as the anchor and applies a small bounded correction for the strongest rival. Reach is local count and maximum weight; arithmetic is constant size, while maximum updates remain charged. Several feasible rivals can defeat the single-rival proxy.

programs.name: residual_context_anchor
programs.rationale: Perturbs count efficiency with bounded compatible-mass credit and blocked-count fraction. Reach includes coarse active-set summaries without new features; their updates remain charged. Compatible mass does not establish a mutually feasible residual schedule.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.12 * compatible_weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight + compatible_weight) - 0.08 * degree / (1 + remaining_count))

programs.name: tapered_resource_bonus
programs.rationale: Adds a small saturated duration bonus relative to the larger actual resource gap while retaining count efficiency. Reach combines root resource attributes and local degree; arithmetic is constant size and degree updates remain charged. Gap occupancy is only approximate.
programs.rule: weight / (1 + degree) * (1 + 0.1 * duration / (1 + duration + max(station_gap, satellite_gap)))

programs.name: dominance_gated_pressure
programs.rationale: Scores isolates directly, relaxes count pressure when reward covers total blocker weight, and adds normalized excess-mass pressure otherwise. Reach is one weighted neighborhood; constant-size conditionals retain summary-update costs. The dominance threshold can change rankings abruptly.
programs.rule: weight if degree == 0 else (weight / (1 + 0.5 * degree) if weight >= conflict_weight else weight / (1 + degree + 0.2 * max(0, conflict_weight - weight) / (1 + weight + max_conflict_weight)))

programs.name: conservative_load_envelope
programs.rationale: Discounts reward by the larger of actual blocker count and reward-normalized blocker mass. Reach is local count and aggregate weight; constant-size arithmetic adds no traversal, while active summaries remain charged. The conservative envelope may penalize mutually conflicting alternatives excessively.

programs.name: reward_with_gap_taper
programs.rationale: Preserves absolute reward scale while applying a bounded discount for gap overhead relative to duration. Reach is root-only; arithmetic adds no graph traversal, though common kernel costs remain. It ignores displacement and treats overlapping resource gaps approximately.
